videos.title: Dabangg
videos.description: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, fights corruption his own way. Cheddi Singh creates a rift with his step-brother, exploiting it for power, forcing Chulbul to battle enemies inside and outside.

videos.title: Khoon Bhari Mang
videos.description: Widowed Aarti is trapped in Sanjay's devious marriage plot. With Nandini's help, he tries to drown her and steal her wealth, but she survives and rises to seek revenge.

videos.title: Vanvaas
videos.description: An elderly father abandoned by his sons and struggling with fading memory begins a heartfelt journey, guided by a clever wanderer determined to reunite him with his family.

videos.title: Kasme Vaade
videos.description: Raju, guilt-ridden over his brother's death, meets Amit's lookalike, Shankar, and unknowingly becomes entangled in a deeper mystery, making amends while facing unsettling truths.

videos.title: Saturday Blockbuster- Phool Aur Kante
videos.description: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

videos.title: De De Pyaar De 2
videos.description: Ashish Mehra, a London-based NRI investor, visits his girlfriend's family, but tensions escalate when her father discovers the truth about Ashish's real age.

videos.title: B.A.Pass 2
videos.description: A young woman escapes an arranged marriage and moves to Mumbai. Alone in the big city, she faces the tough world of showbiz and discovers the real meaning of life and love.

videos.title: Rashmi Rocket
videos.description: A small-town girl rises to become a national athlete, breaking barriers. Her glory is shattered when she's forced into a humiliating gender test, challenging her dreams.

videos.title: Pure Bollywood
videos.description: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

videos.title: Mere Pyaare Prime Minister
videos.description: Kannu, an eight-year-old boy, writes to India's prime minister after his mother is raped. With two friends, he journeys from Mumbai to Delhi, bravely seeking justice.

videos.title: Kaho Naa Pyar Hai
videos.description: After Rohit's mysterious death, Sonia relocates to New Zealand to heal. There, she meets Raj-Rohit's lookalike-who helps her uncover the truth behind Rohit's murder.

videos.title: Air India Around the World- Dil Chahta Hai
videos.description: Three inseparable friends drift apart after college-Akash moves to Australia, Sameer chases love, and Siddharth immerses in art-each following a different path.

videos.title: No Entry
videos.description: Kishan, a loyal husband, disapproves of his friend Prem's infidelity. But when introduced to Bobby, a prostitute, Kishan's morals are tested, leading to complications, secrets, and unexpected choices.

videos.title: Mega Double Premiere- Bhoot Bangla
videos.description: Arjun inherits his family's haunted estate in rural Mangalpur and hosts his sister Meera's wedding there, accidentally unleashing supernatural forces linked to their dark ancestral legacy.

videos.title: Bhoot Bangla
videos.description: (Extended version) Arjun inherits his family's haunted estate in rural Mangalpur and hosts his sister Meera's wedding there, accidentally unleashing supernatural forces linked to their dark ancestral.

videos.title: Zeher
videos.description: Siddharth, a police officer facing divorce, begins an affair with Anna. When she's found dead, he realises he's entangled in a dangerous mystery beyond his control.

videos.title: Krazzy 4
videos.description: A doctor takes four intellectually disabled patients to a cricket match but gets kidnapped. The four team up with a TV channel girl to find and rescue her.

videos.title: Pure Bollywood
videos.description: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

videos.title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
videos.description: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

videos.title: Koi Mil Gaya
videos.description: Rohit, a mentally challenged youth, befriends an alien. When police discover the creature, they try to capture it, while Rohit bravely protects his extraordinary friend against all odds.

videos.title: Ek Deewane ki Deewaniyat
videos.description: When a powerful politician falls for a strong-willed superstar, their intense romance spirals into a perilous clash of desire and ego, turning love into a battle of passion and heartbreak.

videos.title: Yamla Pagla Deewana 2
videos.description: Dharam and Gajodhar, a father-son duo, pose as owners of a huge company to con a business tycoon, but things spiral when Gajodhar's brother joins the scheme.

videos.title: Singh Is King
videos.description: (Movies @6) Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

videos.title: Super Singh
videos.description: Super Singh, a carefree man living with his mother in Canada, gains superpowers and returns to Punjab to battle drug lords and corrupt politicians threatening his homeland.
